newsitem.title: USA: Grove sees closing of new equity March 14.
newsitem.headline: Grove sees closing of new equity March 14.

text.p: Grove Real Estate Trust said on Thursday that the formal closing of the date for converting various Grove partnerships into new equity is expected to be Friday March 14, rather than today, as was anticipated.
As part of its consolidation, the company said it raised $30 million of new equity through an issuance of common shares.
The company said the American Stock Exchange, anticipating the completion of the consolidation today, changed the company symbol.
AMEX trading is expected to resume as soon as possible under the old symbol, until the closing is formalized tomorrow, the company said it was advised by the AMEX.
